native_filter_ctest.scope: one CTest, 14 recurrence cases: seven lengths each with transfer orders 2 and 10 (order-5 bandpass fixture)

recording.record: BIDMC01, entire 480 s recording; first 10 s excluded from metrics
recording.input: pulse-oximeter PPG, not camera video; original [0,1] amplitude retained
recording.processing: linear offline resampling 125 Hz to 30 Hz; recovered Butterworth/window/peak/count/smoothing chain; guarded mode disables forced peaks and gates flat/missing input
recording.reference: ECG-derived HR at 1 Hz, not PPG-derived PULSE; no lag fitting or rate tuning

previous_validation.evidence: The macOS reference harness compiles the unchanged original Objective-C++ algorithm with a minimal UIKit interface. Green-component traces match on tested synthetic inputs; raw-frame float precision differs explicitly. Original buffer overflow is confirmed by AddressSanitizer and avoided in the Python implementation. The historical flat-input 72 bpm placeholder is deliberately preserved and documented.
